text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a fan event being held today<n>in the lead-up
to the autumn Tenno<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A huge, once-in-a-decade movement<n>is taking place
in the Umamusume<n>world this year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's her. That's Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she looks intense...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are people scared of me? But<n>why?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: It's Oguri Cap! She's here!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-gu-ri! O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What's happening?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
If you'll allow me to begin, let's start<n>with the
red-hot Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel to race with such a<n>monumental
obstacle, Oguri Cap the<n>"Hero," standing in your
way?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Obstacle? Hero?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, I'll do my best? Is that good<n>enough?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
And over here, we have Oguri Cap<n>charging in to
attack from the<n>countryside! You're already a
national superstar.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Fall is finally upon us. Can you hear<n>the cheers
from your fans?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I hear them. When I'm not asleep,<n>that is.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-gu-ri! O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hold on... Are you telling me that<n>everyone sees me
as the villain?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it from the crowds in the<n>stands... Oguri
Cap's popularity is out<n>of this world.

Super Creek might be playing the<n>antihero in this
story.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's almost like that time at the spring<n>Classics.
Everyone was so cold and<n>distant because I was
ill.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Actually... could you leave this to me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I've got an idea of my own. I'll try<n>saying it in front
of everyone. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone! If you think Oguri's<n>the strongest
around, then you're<n>sorely mistaken! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I, Super Creek, along with my trainer,<n>will knock
Oguri down a peg at the<n>autumn Tenno Sho! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. You'll make a worthy<n>opponent, Super
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw everything we have at<n>each other. But I
won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-gu-ri! O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I ask Super Creek where her<n>confident outburst
came from.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm, it kind of occurred to me that<n>saying things
like that would make<n>everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to do that for them since I<n>love making
everyone smile.

And if I can do that through racing,<n>then I don't
mind taking a bit of flak.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have the composure during<n>my bad spell,
but I can handle it now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Especially since you've built me up<n>so much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's decided to play the villain for<n>her fans—the
kindest villain in the<n>world.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, also... Would you mind playing the<n>villain with
me? And then...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's finish the race with a result so<n>great that
everyone can't help but to<n>detest us. It won't be
exciting unless<n>we're formidable.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek plans to envelop Oguri's
unprecedented popularity with her<n>nurturing love.
